title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think kings, continents, oceans and tropics.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Monarchies
groups.fact: Japan's imperial line is often called the oldest continuous hereditary monarchy in the world.

groups.name: Spans two continents
groups.fact: Istanbul sits on both Europe and Asia, split by the Bosphorus.

groups.name: Coasts on both the Atlantic and the Pacific
groups.fact: Colombia has coasts on both the Caribbean Sea and the Pacific Ocean.

groups.name: Crossed by the Tropic of Capricorn
groups.fact: The Tropic of Capricorn is the southernmost latitude where the Sun can be directly overhead.
